title: Review of lab 1's swimevo (SID): fresh seeds 7 and 8 give swimming crescents from a near-uniform start that divide to generation 2-3 (7 and 5 persistent splits), but merges outnumber splits (1.29) and the population falls from ~30 to 10
summary: First labkit pack of threads/chemotaxis-motility/worlds/swimevo/world.py on fresh seeds 7 and 8 (160^2, 1200 t). From a near-uniform noisy field (t=0) spots form by t~48 and turn into crescents that swim (55 and 50 tracks >= 1 body length, max 12.8 and 16.0); bodies split and fuse; a second allele colour (orange) spreads after t~600 (pack/seed7/sheet.png). Seed 7: 48 splits, 7 persistent, generation 3, 62 merges; seed 8: 49 / 5 / 2 / 63. Body count peaks at 30-32 and ends at 10 on both seeds.

observations.S: pack/seed7/sheet.png t=0: near-uniform noisy field; bodies by t=48
observations.I: pack/seed7/sheet.png t=102-1200: discrete crescents at bounded size
observations.D: pack/seed7/lineage.png: 7 persistent splits, generation 3 from founders formed from noise; seed 8: 5, generation 2

verdicts.limitation: Reticulate: merges exceed splits (merge/split 1.29 on both seeds), so confidence is medium at most; the population declines (30 -> 10 bodies), so reproduction does not keep up with fusion. The allele spread was not analysed (L7 is out of scope of this re-run).
